raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions ignores the currency column, so 85 EUR-denominated amounts are summed as if they were USD in every gold table. raw_fx_rates has a single EUR rate (1.25 to USD, as of 2026-01-01), so the fix converts amounts to USD in silver using that rate.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(CAST(t.amount AS DOUBLE) * CASE WHEN upper(t.currency) = 'USD' THEN 1.0 ELSE f.rate_to_usd END, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON upper(t.currency) = upper(f.currency) WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
